description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kosgoda, Kuruwita D/S Division, Rathnapura District  -  Cad. Map No 620275 and other declarations
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, owner identities, and property rights. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land registration and title settlement processes, which clearly falls under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
